description.en: Collects and uploads TV problem logs.
description.ms: Mengumpul dan memuat naik log masalah TV.

effect.en: TCL loses problem logs collected by this reporter.
effect.ms: TCL kehilangan log masalah yang dikumpulkan oleh pelapor ini.

description.en: Shows TCL messages and promotional content.
description.ms: Memaparkan mesej dan kandungan promosi TCL.

effect.en: TCL messages and promotions stop appearing until restored.
effect.ms: Mesej dan promosi TCL berhenti dipaparkan sehingga dipulihkan.

description.en: Shows promotional stickers used when the TV is on display in a shop.
description.ms: Memaparkan pelekat promosi yang digunakan apabila TV dipamerkan di kedai.

effect.en: Shop demo stickers stop appearing until restored.
effect.ms: Pelekat demo kedai berhenti dipaparkan sehingga dipulihkan.

description.en: Provides Alexa features on supported TCL TVs.
description.ms: Menyediakan ciri Alexa pada TV TCL yang disokong.

effect.en: Alexa features provided by this app stop working until restored.
effect.ms: Ciri Alexa yang disediakan oleh aplikasi ini berhenti berfungsi sehingga dipulihkan.

description.en: Receives wireless screen mirroring from compatible devices.
description.ms: Menerima pencerminan skrin tanpa wayar daripada peranti yang serasi.

effect.en: Miracast screen mirroring stops working until restored.
effect.ms: Pencerminan skrin Miracast berhenti berfungsi sehingga dipulihkan.

description.en: Handles viewing data, casting, voice services or TV updates, depending on the model.
description.ms: Mengendalikan data tontonan, casting, perkhidmatan suara atau kemas kini TV, bergantung pada model.

effect.en: Casting, voice features or TV software updates may stop working; protected.
effect.ms: Casting, ciri suara atau kemas kini perisian TV mungkin berhenti berfungsi; dilindungi.

description.en: Plays live TV and HDMI inputs on TCL TVs.
description.ms: Memainkan TV langsung dan input HDMI pada TV TCL.

effect.en: Live TV and HDMI viewing may stop working; protected.
effect.ms: Tontonan TV langsung dan HDMI mungkin berhenti berfungsi; dilindungi.

description.en: Connects HDMI, antenna and other TV inputs to apps.
description.ms: Menyambungkan HDMI, antena dan input TV lain kepada aplikasi.

effect.en: HDMI, antenna and other TV inputs may stop working; protected.
effect.ms: HDMI, antena dan input TV lain mungkin berhenti berfungsi; dilindungi.

description.en: Pairs supported Bluetooth remotes with the TV.
description.ms: Menyandingkan alat kawalan jauh Bluetooth yang disokong dengan TV.

effect.en: Bluetooth remote pairing may stop working; protected.
effect.ms: Penyandingan alat kawalan jauh Bluetooth mungkin berhenti berfungsi; dilindungi.

effect.en: Initial TV setup or related system functions may stop working; protected.
effect.ms: Persediaan awal TV atau fungsi sistem berkaitan mungkin berhenti berfungsi; dilindungi.

description.en: Opens the input panel used by the remote Input button.
description.ms: Membuka panel input yang digunakan oleh butang Input pada alat kawalan jauh.

effect.en: The remote Input button or input panel may stop working; protected.
effect.ms: Butang Input atau panel input alat kawalan jauh mungkin berhenti berfungsi; dilindungi.

description.en: Provides TCL picture and sound settings.
description.ms: Menyediakan tetapan gambar dan bunyi TCL.

effect.en: Picture and sound settings may stop working; protected.
effect.ms: Tetapan gambar dan bunyi mungkin berhenti berfungsi; dilindungi.
